title: Exculpation of trustee.
bodyText:
A term of a trust relieving a trustee of liability for breach of trust is unenforceable to the extent that it:

(1) Relieves the trustee of liability for breach of trust committed in bad faith or with reckless indifference to the purposes of the trust or the interests of the beneficiaries; or

(2) Was inserted as the result of an abuse by the trustee of either a fiduciary or confidential relationship to the settlor.
bodyHtml:
[§554D-1008]  Exculpation of trustee.  A term of a trust relieving a trustee of liability for breach of trust is unenforceable to the extent that it:

     (1)  Relieves the trustee of liability for breach of trust committed in bad faith or with reckless indifference to the purposes of the trust or the interests of the beneficiaries; or

     (2)  Was inserted as the result of an abuse by the trustee of either a fiduciary or confidential relationship to the settlor. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
